The hop chain begins at `serveUserAvatar` in `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`, then `getUserByUsername` in the same file, and finally `GetUser` in `store/user.go`.

`ListUsers` in `store/user.go` queries `avatar_url` from the user table. The database layer is reached through `Driver.ListUsers` in `store/driver.go`, which delegates to `DB.ListUsers` in `store/db/sqlite/user.go` (and the MySQL/PostgreSQL equivalents).
